correctness.rationale: For undirected K_{1,1,n} with one spine endpoint sink and n>=2, a stable recurrent state has spine height h in 0..n, tip heights eta_i in {0,1}. Dhar forbidden-subconfiguration criterion is equivalent to h>=z=#{i:eta_i=0}. Counting sums binom(n,z)(n-z+1)=(n+2)2^{n-1}. Addition at spine h=n topples spine once plus exactly height-one tips; h<n gives zero. At a tip: eta_j=0 gives zero, eta_j=1,h<n gives tip only, eta_j=1,h=n gives tip then spine then all other height-one tips. Every nonsink topples at most once. This exhausts source cases and yields the stated multivariate polynomial. Specializing yields the given binomial tails, E T=1 at either specified source, exact variances and rare conditional Bin(n,1/2)-scale large events. Independent enumeration of all recurrent states and individual legal topplings for n=2..6 exactly matched the coefficientwise multivariate formula. Not evidence of infinite proof, which is the burning-plus-case analysis.
residual_risks: Independent finite calculations corroborate only tested parameters; all-size reasoning relies on reviewed proof.
